# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 3 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 3 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_003_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 3

**3:1** Looking up toward heaven, she noticed a nest of sparrows in the laurel tree. This sight moved her to lament within herself:

**3:2** "Woe to me — who gave birth to me? What womb brought me into existence? For I came into being as a curse among the children of Israel. I have been reproached and mocked, and they have driven me away from the temple of the Lord.

**3:3** "Woe to me — to what can I compare myself? I cannot compare myself to the birds of heaven, for even the birds of heaven are fruitful before you, O Lord.

**3:4** "Woe to me — to what can I compare myself? I cannot compare myself to the beasts of the earth, for even the beasts of the earth are fruitful before you, O Lord.

**3:5** "Woe to me — to what can I compare myself? I cannot compare myself to these waters, for even these waters are fruitful before you, O Lord.

**3:6** "Woe to me — to what can I compare myself? I cannot compare myself to the earth itself, for the earth brings forth its fruit in due season and blesses you, O Lord."
